```yaml
name: TS Audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Apply Fern override to ignore x-session-access-key header
        run: |
          echo "applying fern override"
          pnpm run fern generate --override '{"paths": ["./fern/api-v3-tool_router_session_execute.yaml"], "overrides": [{"path": "/api/v3/tool_router/session/{session_id}/execute", "parameters": [{"name": "x-session-access-key", "in": "header", "x-fern-ignore": true}]}]}' --output ./fern/generated

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Hide x-session-access-key header from API docs"

      - name: Push changes
        run: git push origin main
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
